question: Who has been appointed as the new Vice Chief of the Indian Air Force on January 30, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amarpreet**__ __**Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The current **VCAS **is** Air Marshal Sujeet Pushpakar Dharkar**.
 
• He succeeded** Air Marshal Amar Preet Singh** to the post on **3 October 2024**.
 
 
• He was commissioned into the fighter stream of the IAF in **December 1984**.
 
• He is an alumnus of the National Defence Academy, Defence Services Staff College, and National Defence College.</li&g
